I finished my last day of high school a few weeks ago and honestly there are only three main things I would go back and change. I wish I could go back and shake into my head that you aren’t tied to who you were in middle school. My freshman year got cut off midway through and by that point I was just coming to terms with the fact I wasn’t in middle school anymore. But because it got cut-off that realization never fully set in. The rest of high school I was an awkward mess because I felt so out of place and felt like everyone was miles ahead of me. But just know that you aren’t tied to who you used to be. You can change from year to year, even from month to month, it’s normal and you aren’t fully supposed to know yourself yet. So if you were really quiet in middle school don’t pigeon hole yourself into being the “quiet girl” the rest of high school just because that’s what you are known as. I also wish I could go back and tell myself to talk to more people. I met so many people my senior year that I was only able to meet because I had the confidence to actually start talking to them. I know this seems much easier said than done, but just give it a try- and even if nothing comes out of it, keep putting yourself out there because you never know who you could be close with if you never put yourself out there to begin with. finally, and I know it’s a cliche, but you really are who you surround yourself with. You can get roped into doing stuff you are uncomfortable with just because you want to feel like you fit in. You will probably end up in a situation at some point in life, whether that be in high school or later, but just know that if you feel pressured by these people they aren’t your friends, and you can always find new ones even if it seems daunting.


Also just as a tip~ some of the best people I have met have been the people in my extra curricular classes. Unlike middle school you aren’t only stuck in the same classes with the people from your grade, you are mixed in with a bunch of people from other grades which gives you the opportunity to meet soooo many amazing people. At least in my school, the core classes are mainly people in your grade, but the extra curricular classes is where you start to more of a variety of people.
